ValidationRule.description: to check if Status is Approved and 'Approved Credit' limit is provided
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $User.LastName <> 'Integration', ISBLANK(cc_Approved_Credit_Limit__c), OR( AND( ISPICKVAL(Type, 'Credit Card Application'), ISPICKVAL(Sub_Type__c, "New Credit Card") ), ISPICKVAL(Type, 'Credit Limit Increase Application'), ISPICKVAL(Type , "Convert Credit Card Nature Application") ), OR( AND( ISCHANGED(cc_HR_Result__c), ISPICKVAL(cc_HR_Result__c,'Approved') ), AND( ISCHANGED(cc_Credit_Evaluation_Result__c), ISPICKVAL(cc_Credit_Evaluation_Result__c,'Accept') )))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please provide the 'Approved Credit Limit' before 'Approving' the Case.
